settings.discussionCount: Number of first discussions to require approval for
settings.discussionCount_help: Set to 0 to hold new discussions for approval based on the number of posts instead.
settings.postCount: Number of first posts to require approval for
settings.postCount_help: Once this many posts by a user have been approved, their posts are published immediately.
settings.restrictPrivateDiscussions_help: Private discussions cannot be held for approval, so users still subject to first post approval are stopped from starting them. Turn this off to let them start private discussions freely.
